reuseDecisions.source: Existing current types, already derived from main load-case concepts
reuseDecisions.decision: Reused for target-case identity instead of inventing LoadCaseIdentity. Snapshot ID/family before submission; do not import main result/UI collections.
Reused for case family and engineering classification. No new LoadCaseFamily enum; deletion accepts only primary/reference.

reuseDecisions.source: Existing current types plus main definitions
reuseDecisions.decision: Forces is reused with defensive copying for fixed-end input and nodal-command output. Existing per-entity loads remain; a command-info class adds native index identity instead of pretending grouping preserves it.
Reused unchanged for future observations. Command-kind and item-kind tables remain distinct.
Added a validated public constructor so the same named type can be supplied as input. No second notional input class or tuple.

Reviewed but not ported as a duplicate: existing SelfWeightDirection plus finite factor already expresses the required request. Main uses LoadDirection codes, so its object is not forwarded numerically.

Reused its four joint-value concept in TrapezoidalPressureDefinition.AtCorners. Did not import Y-up fluid computation, four-decimal text output, invalid-direction fallback or equality-by-plate-ID into a native request.
Reused direction, magnitude and local-coordinate fields in PlateConcentratedLoad. Main ApplyTo is NotImplementedException and uses proprietary bases/extensions; those are not copied.

reuseDecisions.source: Existing current models and main definitions
reuseDecisions.decision: Retained existing supplied-definition APIs. The main LoadCombinationsDefinition is application/template/file-persistence oriented; it does not describe native code/category automatic generation and is not ported into that request.
Ported the simple X/Y/Z semantic enum with explicit 0/1/2 values and XML documentation. Future native services translate separately for 1/2/3 interpolation/ranges.

reuseDecisions.source: Already ported Models/Loads/Wind and Seismic families
reuseDecisions.decision: Reused for their existing definition APIs. WindLoadDefinition is new because it applies a definition to a case with direction/region; it is not an alternative ASCE definition.
UI/storage/selection orchestration is not a native operation/result contract. No new dependency on ReInvented.Shared or proprietary OpenSTAADUI is introduced.
